services.name: Copter Cash
services.desc: 15 Minutes About Copter Cash: Trivia in The Sky Over Sarasota. Are you a game show buff with a thirst for adventure? Come aboard Sarasota Helicopter Tours for Copter Cash! Experience the thrill of soaring over beautiful Sarasota while answering questions and racing against the clock to win exciting cash prizes! Note: All participants are required to sign an Appearance Release 15 Minutes • Up to 2 People

blurb: Guests fly in air-conditioned Robinson R44 Raven II helicopters with a pilot-owner. Tours offer aerial views of Sarasota's coastline, islands, and marine life, with options for doors on or off. Private charters serve business and leisure travel anywhere in Florida and beyond, with flexible scheduling and personalized service.
